description: This Java test source file contains unit tests for the BinaryStreamHandler class in the OpenMRS project, verifying view support and observation data handling.

classes.name: BinaryStreamHandlerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for BinaryStreamHandler, testing view support and data saving in the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: shouldReturnSupportedViews
methods.description: Tests that the handler returns the correct supported views array, specifically RAW_VIEW.

methods.name: shouldSupportRawView
methods.description: Verifies that the handler supports the RAW_VIEW.

methods.name: shouldNotSupportOtherViews
methods.description: Ensures the handler does not support other views like HTML, PREVIEW, TEXT, TITLE, URI, empty, or null.

methods.name: saveObs_shouldRetrieveCorrectMimetype
methods.description: Tests that saving an Obs with complex data correctly sets the MIME type and can retrieve the Obs with proper data.
